title: Manifest
description: data/manifest.json. It names the build, and `python -m pipeline check` reads it to decide whether a rebuild is needed.

schemaVersion.description: The version of this contract. The web app refuses data that carries another number. Raise it whenever a schema change breaks an older reader.

minecraftVersion.description: The Minecraft Java Edition release that this build describes. The value comes from the Mojang version manifest.

mcmetaRef.description: The misode/mcmeta tag that the build read. A tag keeps the build reproducible, and a bare branch head does not.

pipelineVersion.description: The version of the pipeline package that wrote this output.

builtAt.description: The time of the build, in UTC.
